articles.summary: We knew at some point Tim Cook would step down from his position as Apple's CEO. Over the last year, it has become increasingly obvious that John Ternus was his likely successor.

articles.title: Maine might soon impose the country's first statewide pause on data centers
articles.summary: Maine might become the first place to impose a statewide pause on big data center construction — if the governor signs the bill.
